articles.title: Introducing dots, always-on agents built to handle everything.
articles.summary: Dots are frontier intelligence that have your back. Powered by GPT‑6 Astra, they have their own cloud computer, learn from feedback over time, and can work towards your goals 24/7.
body: Your dot is always within reach, whether it is through ChatGPT, Slack, or Teams. You can ask questions, explore ideas, and give feedback along the way; or you can simply hop on a voice call when you need to talk something out. The more you work together, the more your dot learns your preferences, how you think, and what good looks like to you.

The magic of dots is when they bring you work done the way you would do it, sometimes before you even think to ask. With dots alongside you, ambitious ideas and projects you haven’t had the time or support to pursue start to feel achievable.

articles.title: The Day Steph Changed the Rules
articles.summary: Before the MVPs, before the four championships, there was this night at the Garden.
body: In this episode of “Anatomy of the Game,” Ben Taylor of Thinking Basketball revisits Steph Curry’s 54-point eruption against the Knicks in February 2013—a glimpse of the superstar who would change how basketball is played and defended.

Ben breaks down how Curry punished New York’s drop coverage and the space defenders gave him beyond the arc, revealing why defensive approaches that once seemed reasonable at the time would soon become impossible to use going forward.

body: Clark delivered a historic 27-point, 15-assist performance to help Indiana beat the Las Vegas Aces and force a decisive Game 3. Chiney is joined by ESPN Senior Researcher Jason Joseph to break down how Clark set the tone, why Indiana’s Big Three finally clicked, and what changed defensively against A’ja Wilson and the Aces.

Plus, the New York Liberty made WNBA history by sweeping the No. 1 seed Minnesota Lynx in the opening round. Chiney and JayJo discuss what went wrong for Minnesota, why New York’s championship experience mattered, and what could be next for the Lynx after a stunning early exit.
